newsitem.title: POLAND: OPTIMUS PLUNGES 10 PCT IN PROFIT-TAKING.
newsitem.headline: OPTIMUS PLUNGES 10 PCT IN PROFIT-TAKING.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA plunged the daily maximum 10 percent to 104 zlotys on profit taking after having surged for much of this year, traders said.

The stock had plunged 10 percent last Wednesday after the firm denied a rumour that Microsoft held most of its convertible bonds and jumped 5.8 percent the next day on a 1997 net-profit forecast showing an 80-percent increase.
"There could be more profit taking in lower turnovers but it seems the stock should continue to vacillate," one trader said. Monday turnover was at 4.6 million zlotys.
